title: 音频混音失衡
description: 音乐音量过大，盖过角色对话，导致对话难以听清，需要调整音乐和对话音量平衡。
evidence: the music sometimes drowns out what your character is saying
turn down the music volume a bit while cranking up the dialogue if you intend to have any idea of what's being said
